OverviewFeaturesUse casesPricingTradeoffsCompatibilityFAQ

What is Pika?

Consumer-oriented video generator focused on fun, shareable short-form effects. Known for Pikaffects (physics-defying transformations like melting, inflating or exploding a subject) and Pikadditions that insert objects into existing video.

Best for

Short-form social video with attention-grabbing effects.

Main features

  • Text-to-video and image-to-video
  • Pikaffects (crush, melt, inflate, explode, cake-ify and similar transformations)
  • Pikadditions inserting a subject into existing footage
  • Pikaswaps replacing elements in a clip
  • Pikascenes combining multiple reference images into one scene
  • lip sync and sound effects
  • Modify Video for restyling
  • 1080p output on paid tiers.

Practical use cases

  • Making a product ad with an eye-catching physical transformation
  • creating shareable short-form social content
  • animating a still photo
  • adding a character or object into existing footage
  • quick visual gags.

Who is it for?

  • Social media creators, TikTok and Reels producers, marketers making viral short-form content, casual users.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription

Plans described in the source

Basic free with roughly 80 monthly credits and watermarked output. Standard around $10/mo ($8 annually, roughly 700 credits, no watermark). Pro around $35/mo ($28 annually, roughly 2,300 credits) with 1080p and faster generation. Fancy/Unlimited around $95/mo ($76 annually) for highest volume and priority. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with monthly credits, watermarked output.

Free trial

Free tier serves as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered per generation, with higher resolution and longer clips costing more. Free tier output is watermarked and limited in resolution. Clip length is short (typically 3-10 seconds).

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The Pikaffects are genuinely distinctive and drive real social engagement - nothing else does them as well
  • very cheap entry price
  • fast generation
  • easy enough for non-technical users
  • strong on the specific format social platforms reward.

Limitations to consider

  • Much shallower than Runway - it does effects, not production
  • clip length is very short
  • narrative or professional use cases are poorly served
  • free tier watermarking makes it unusable for business without paying
  • quality and consistency are inconsistent
  • limited control over composition
  • smaller company with uncertain roadmap.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android, Discord

Languages

  • English prompts and interface

API access

Limited - check current developer access

Integrations and exports

  • Discord
  • direct social sharing
  • export to MP4

Evaluation notes

Pika and Runway are not really competitors - Pika is for social novelty, Runway for production. Evaluate Pika only against the specific effects you intend to use.
